service.name: MRI lower extremity joint without contrast

criteria.label: Knee pain or internal derangement diagnosis
criteria.met_rationale: A qualifying knee diagnosis is present.
criteria.missing_action: Add a current diagnosis supporting the requested knee MRI.

criteria.label: Recent knee radiograph
criteria.missing_action: Attach knee radiograph report from the last 90 days or document why radiography is not appropriate.

criteria.label: Six weeks of conservative management
criteria.missing_action: Collect PT/home exercise notes and medication history showing at least six weeks of conservative care.

criteria.label: Mechanical symptoms or functional limitation
criteria.met_rationale: Functional limitation or mechanical symptoms are documented.
criteria.missing_action: Document locking, catching, instability, or functional limitation in the clinical note.

criteria.label: Acute knee trauma
criteria.missing_action: Add trauma diagnosis and injury mechanism if urgent imaging pathway is being used.

pathways.label: Non-urgent MRI after failed conservative management
